verdict.rationale: Docs confirm CI integration triggered on push/PR/MR events and that Semgrep Secrets posts comments directly on PRs/MRs; guides explicitly cover setting up Semgrep jobs for GitHub/GitLab CI. However, general PR-comment/check functionality for Semgrep Code/SCA findings (not just Secrets) isn't explicitly documented in this pack, and no community evidence directly confirms the PR-comment UX in practice.
